name: Data.card_matrix_le_tupleBound
summary: |R|^{|p||q|} ≤ |R|^{(2n_m)²} since both index sets have at most 2n_m elements.

steps.claim: The number of matrices is |R|^{|NodeIndex p|·|NodeIndex q|}; tupleBound(ϑ) = |R|^{(2n_m)²}.
Both index sets have at most 2n_m elements (`Data.card_gridIndex_le`) and |R| ≥ 1, so the power is monotone.
